title: Outlier Detection
description: Master outlier detection techniques to identify anomalous data points that can skew analysis and model performance. Learn the IQR method for robust statistical detection, Z-score for parametric approaches, Isolation Forest for tree-based anomaly detection, DBSCAN for density-based clustering, and Local Outlier Factor for neighborhood-based methods. These techniques are essential for data cleaning, fraud detection, anomaly detection, and robust statistical analysis.
